content.title: Get out and meet up
content.summary: A short, adult-led home fire escape practice. Find two ways out, walk to your meeting spot outside, and count everyone.
content.objective: Practice a home fire escape plan together: two ways out, a meeting spot outside, a head count, and staying out.

sources.label: American Red Cross — Home fire safety and escape plans
U.S. Fire Administration — Home fire escape plans
NFPA — How to make a home fire escape plan

content.facilitation: You lead. Walk through your own home at a calm pace, one step at a time. Pass the phone only when a step says so. If a step is not working for your household, skip it and talk it through instead.

practiced_home_fire_escape.text: Your household practiced getting out and meeting up together.

turns.say: Let's find two ways out of this room.
turns.grownUp: Point to the door, then a window. Today we only point. Later, a grown-up checks that doors and windows open easily and whether upstairs needs an escape ladder.

turns.say: Walk together to our meeting spot outside.
turns.grownUp: Walk out with everyone. Say where your meeting spot is: outside the home, where everyone meets.

turns.say: Point to our meeting spot. Then lead everyone there.
turns.grownUp: Follow the Checker. Look at your household plan together to see if this is the spot you chose.

turns.say: At the meeting spot, count everyone out loud.
turns.grownUp: Help count every person in your household, including you. Say it is how we know we are all out.

turns.say: Why do we all meet at the same spot?
turns.grownUp: Listen to the answer. A good answer: so we can count everyone and know we are all out.
turns.ask: Why do we all meet at the same spot outside?

turns.say: What do we do once we are outside?
turns.grownUp: Say it together: once we are out, we stay out, even for a pet or a toy. A grown-up calls 911 from outside.
turns.ask: Once we are out, do we go back in?

activity.remember: Two ways out. Get out and stay out. Meet at our spot and count everyone.
activity.talkAboutIt: What would we do if one way out were blocked?
followUps: Check that every room has two ways out
Pick one meeting spot outside, together
activity.nextPrompt: Check your meeting place in your plan.
activity.nextNote: Opens your real plan. Nothing changes unless you save it.
